about: Spot ETF holdings read by hand from the issuer's own page where the issuer publishes no file the daily job can fetch. Each row: the as-of date the issuer prints, the quantity, the day it was read and who read it. Committed by the founder after the weekly check; copied into etf.json by tools/etf.mjs, marked as read by hand.

rows.by: founder, Fidelity quote page (Total bitcoin in fund, as of Nov-05-2026)
